card.name: Web addresses and health agency citations
card.fires_on: Pieces of web addresses (www, ://, directory names) and the small words or punctuation inside or right after names of health agencies like CDC, NIH, NINDS and AAOS, in patient-education and reference text.

modes.label: URL parts
modes.description: Pieces of a web address such as www, the :// after http, or a folder name.

modes.label: Agency name surroundings
modes.description: The word the, a comma, a bracket or a period near a health organization name or citation.

modes.label: Partway through medical terms
modes.description: The middle of a long medical term such as non-radiographic.
